prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: painted overview terrain for a Godot 2D xianxia sect mountain-domain exploration prototype, wide landscape 3072x1728.
Primary request: paint one breathtaking vast coherent mountain range seen from a fixed high oblique bird's-eye angle, in the same refined hand-painted Chinese fantasy game art style as the reference image. This is the same natural domain around an early five-person founding courtyard, spanning multiple kilometers.
Input image role: visual style reference only; extend its jade blue water, cream limestone cliffs, ancient green pines, sunlit detailed hand painting and atmospheric clouds to a far higher and much wider aerial view.
Composition: entire terrain map fills frame, no sky or horizon. A central broad flat main-peak terrace at (52% width,45% height); two near subsidiary peaks at (28%,59%) and (76%,58%); two distant peaks at (25%,25%) and (79%,23%); a western outer fertile valley at (18%,75%) and eastern wooded residential terrace at (70%,73%). The five principal peaks have generous natural buildable flat summits; all are surrounded by deep ravines and sweeping pine forests, luminous mist and waterfalls. Small continuous winding stone footpaths and narrow ancient stone bridges wind between peaks and valleys. Center terrace can hold a very tiny simple cluster of dark green roofs, close to invisible at this grand scale. All other peaks retain untouched natural stone and pines. Main river meanders diagonally through lower valley. Strong layered depth, huge geographical separation, beautiful luxurious immortal-realm atmosphere created by nature and light.
Lighting: soft clear morning gold over blue-green mountain shadow, subtle mist, crisp readable near ridges, atmospheric distant ridges. Unbroken painting across the entire frame. No labels, no text, no map pins, no UI, no frames, no humans, no close large palace buildings. Render detailed artistic terrain as a real game background asset.
